justification: Reads the signed-in account's setup state and number aliases. Sends nothing, changes nothing, stays inside BreakPass.
Reads the saved Inform, Acknowledge and Escalate workflows. No side effects.
Reads delivery and acknowledgement history of alerts this client started. No side effects.

Sends one WhatsApp message to the owner's verified number. It contacts a real person outside BreakPass and spends balance, and a sent message cannot be recalled, so it is marked destructive. It deletes or overwrites nothing in BreakPass.

Sends one SMS to a verified number. It contacts a real person outside BreakPass and spends balance, and a sent text cannot be recalled, so it is marked destructive. It deletes or overwrites nothing in BreakPass.

Places one phone call that reads the message aloud. It contacts a real person outside BreakPass and spends balance, and a call cannot be taken back, so it is marked destructive. It deletes or overwrites nothing in BreakPass.

Starts a server-side workflow that messages and may call the owner until acknowledged. It contacts a real person outside BreakPass and spends balance, and messages already sent cannot be recalled, so it is marked destructive. Idempotent with an idempotency_key; nothing in BreakPass is deleted.
Stops the unsent steps of an alert, which cannot be undone (hence destructive), and may affect a call already ringing (open world). Safe to call twice.
